scripts.clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path renderer) { Remove-Item renderer -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path dist-installer) { Remove-Item dist-installer -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item dist -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path release) { Remove-Item release -Recurse -Force }"
scripts.build:renderer: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Set-Location C:\flowops\frontend; npm run build; Set-Location C:\flowops\desktop; if (Test-Path renderer) { Remove-Item renderer -Recurse -Force }; Copy-Item C:\flowops\frontend\dist renderer -Recurse"
scripts.dist: npm run build:renderer && npx electron-builder --win dir
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npx electron-builder --win dir
